# Eaton — financial and market snapshot
**As of September 13, 2026.** All monetary amounts below are in **full USD units**, except per-share figures. Source-rounded amounts retain their original precision.

**Comparability limitation:** Published TTM figures were available, but the retrieved market-data page did not explicitly display their period-end date. They are identified separately from dated company filings; missing definitions and dates have not been inferred.

result.notes: Research date: 2026-09-13. All monetary fields use full USD units, except per-share amounts. S2 market capitalization, enterprise value and TTM data were retrieved 2026-09-13; separate capitalization timestamps and the TTM period end were not displayed. The price is the 2026-09-11 regular-session close, not a live research-date quote. S5 reported USD 425.32 at 15:59:56 EDT that day; S2's later 16:00 close was selected. S2 separately reported an after-hours quote of USD 426.48 at 19:59 EDT. S2's TTM net income of USD 3830000000 lacks verified shareholder attribution, and its EPS of USD 9.82 is not explicitly diluted; those standardized fields remain null. The cash field contains S1's June 30, 2026 line labelled 'Cash', excluding USD 212000000 of separately reported short-term investments. S2's USD 695000000 cash presentation combines these categories. S2's USD 21330000000 debt figure has unverified lease treatment and was not substituted. S1 verifies June 30 short-term debt of USD 2091000000 and current long-term debt of USD 11000000, but the remaining required component was unavailable; no debt total was calculated. S1 and S4 are versions of the same July 31, 2026 filing supporting the share disclosures. Annual history revenue and shareholder-attributable net income are US GAAP; free cash flow is source-stated, rounded and non-GAAP. FY2025 financial statements are dated 2026-02-26; S3's narrative publication day was not verified. Growth EPS is adjusted, not GAAP diluted EPS. S8 consensus is third-party S&P Global data updated 2026-09-07, with EPS accounting basis unspecified; the target is a one-year mean across 27 analysts. S8 also states FY2027 revenue of USD 36570000000 and EPS of USD 16.13 for the year ending 2027-12-31. Sector KPIs were published 2026-07-31.
